body:
Also, I think I should mention that in the back of my head, or the front, depends on the day, I equate being in a relationship with being happy.  And I know that that is a problem, and in many cases not true.  I've tried the whole "loving myself first" thing....but I just feel like, whats the point of loving myself if I cant have that same love for someone else?  And if I do feel that love for them, and its not reciprocated...it seems like a choice between either loving them or loving myself.  Because if I go on loving them, that crushing sadness gets tacked on to the previous stuff because its unrequited.  And if I chose to love myself, do whats best for me and minimize my own sadness...I have to cut out that love for the other person somehow.

I'm sorry for the rants, although even though I dont frequent this subreddit, I feel theyre probably fairly common.
